title: A National Screening Framework for Critical Mineral Potential and Heavy-Metal Hazard in U.S. Mine Waste: Dataset and Atlas (v0.1.0)
description: Screening dataset and interactive atlas ranking the 1,498 features of the USGS National Mine Waste Inventory v2.0 (October 2026) for critical-mineral enrichment and heavy-metal hazard, using public USGS geochemical samples (Granitto and others, 2026) within 2 km of each feature, U.S. soil background, EPA residential soil screening levels, and the Final 2025 U.S. List of Critical Minerals. Includes per-feature and per-site ranked tables, per-element enrichment and hazard values, quality report, code, and manuscript. Screening tool only; not a resource estimate or risk assessment.
